verdict.rationale: Swell's AI-related evidence (docs-3, docs-9, docs-21-23, skills repo) is entirely about enabling AI coding agents to build/customize the platform via schema APIs and CLI tooling — not about the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from a merchant's store data (sales trends, customer behavior, etc.). The only data-analysis feature mentioned (docs-35, 'detailed reports') is standard analytics with no AI generation claimed.
